flags.title: NextGenerationEU reaches implementation deadline
flags.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 31 Aug 2026 Today marks an important milestone for the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU, as Member States reach the final implementation deadline for the reforms and investments set out in their national recovery and resilience plans. This is a defining moment for the EU's unprecedented common response to two major crises: the COVID-19 pandemic and Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

Europe Today: Iceland says no to EU talks, Hoekstra warns on wildfires and China
flags.summary: Iceland has voted "No" to resuming EU accession talks, shelving membership hopes for years. Europe Today breaks down the result with farming and pro-EU voices from Reykjavík, hears from Climate Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra, and reports from Mons on NATO's spy scandal.

flags.title: The CIA’s visit to Moscow shows Nato is working — and it’s a reminder that Europe still matters to Washington
flags.summary: While overstating hybrid threats against the Baltics, commentators often understate what Russia is doing right now. It commits daily war crimes against civilian targets in Ukraine. Sabotage, arson and cyber-attacks on European allies are deadly serious, and getting worse, writes Edward Lucas.

Magyar says EU must decide whether to 'survive or win' and slams Brussels' lack of leadership
flags.summary: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar told the Bled Strategic Forum that the EU faces a leadership crisis and must make crucial decisions on its future. He also criticised Brussels' daily migration fines against Hungary, calling them unfair despite a 2020 EU court ruling.
